predict.question: Free entry has a 20% chance of +12 points and an 80% chance of -3. Over many entries under these rules, what is the mean net points per entry?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Predictably Irrational questions whether the attraction of free options supports good comparisons.
modelBoundary: Free entry averages {A}; paid entry {B}. Net outcomes include entry fees; different chances and consequences outweigh the free label.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This invented game cannot establish a psychological zero-price effect.
